temperature.observed: unset: not sent; set to 0.37: sent as temperature

max_output_tokens.observed: unset: not sent; set to 777: sent as max_tokens

max_steps.observed: max_steps 3: 3 model calls, end_state step_limit, harness counted 3
max_steps.native: RunConfig.max_llm_calls, set each turn to the steps left

parallel_tool_calls.observed: unset: not sent; set to False: sent as parallel_tool_calls
parallel_tool_calls.native: LiteLlm(parallel_tool_calls=...), passed through to the request

memory.observed: off: the Runner gets no memory service, so nothing is stored or recalled. ADK has memory services; the adapter does not wire them yet
memory.evidence: declared:a request cannot show memory being off

skills.observed: off: the agent gets no skills toolset. ADK has skills support; the adapter does not wire it yet
skills.evidence: declared:a request cannot show skills being off

compression.observed: off: no events compaction and no context cache; the whole session history is sent each call
compression.evidence: declared:a request cannot show compression being off

known_differences: ADK appends its identity line ('You are an agent. Your internal name is "assistant".') and, with MCP tools, a fencing preamble to the system prompt, each after a blank line; the task prompt comes first, unchanged (D20)
Every MCP tool and parameter description is wrapped as '<<<BEGIN_UNTRUSTED_TOOL_DESCRIPTION>>>\n' + text + '\n<<<END_UNTRUSTED_TOOL_DESCRIPTION>>>' (D20); names and schemas are otherwise unchanged
Tool results reach the model as the whole MCP result in JSON ({"content": [...], "isError": false}), not the text alone

A tool call whose arguments do not parse is dropped; ADK's ReflectAndRetryModelPlugin puts a call to adk_handle_model_error (not in the tools list) with reflection guidance in its place, and the model never sees its own call. After 3 in a row the turn ends as agent_error (D18)
An unknown tool name gets ADK's own error text back as the tool result (D18)
Replayed tool-call arguments are re-serialised by ADK from the parsed arguments
